texts.1jn.4.3: E todo o espirito que não confessa que Jesus Christo veiu em carne não é de Deus; e tal é o espirito do anti-christo, do qual já ouvistes que ha de vir, e já agora está no mundo.
texts.1jn.4.4: Filhinhos, sois de Deus, e já o tendes vencido; porque maior é o que está em vós do que o que está no mundo.
texts.1jn.4.5: Do mundo são, por isso fallam do mundo, e o mundo os ouve.
texts.1jn.4.6: Nós somos de Deus; aquelle que conhece a Deus ouve-nos; aquelle que não é de Deus não nos ouve. N’isto conhecemos nós o espirito da verdade e o espirito do erro.
texts.1jn.4.7: Amados, amemo-nos uns aos outros; porque a caridade é de Deus; e qualquer que ama é nascido de Deus e conhece a Deus.
texts.1jn.4.8: Aquelle que não ama não tem conhecido a Deus; porque Deus é caridade.
texts.1jn.4.9: N’isto se manifestou a caridade de Deus para comnosco: que Deus enviou seu Filho unigenito ao mundo, para que por elle vivamos.
texts.1jn.4.10: N’isto está a caridade, não que nós tenhamos amado a Deus, mas que elle nos amou a nós, e enviou seu Filho para propiciação pelos nossos peccados.
texts.1jn.4.11: Amados, se Deus assim nos amou, tambem nos devemos amar uns aos outros.
texts.1jn.4.12: Ninguem jámais viu a Deus; e, se nos amamos uns aos outros, Deus está em nós, e em nós é perfeita a sua caridade.
texts.1jn.4.13: N’isto conhecemos que estamos n’elle, e elle em nós, porquanto nos deu do seu Espirito,
texts.1jn.4.14: E vimos, e testificamos que o Pae enviou seu Filho para Salvador do mundo.
texts.1jn.4.15: Qualquer que confessar que Jesus é o Filho de Deus, Deus está n’elle, e elle em Deus.
texts.1jn.4.16: E nós conhecemos, e cremos o amor que Deus nos tem. Deus é caridade; e quem está em caridade está em Deus, e Deus n’elle.
texts.1jn.4.17: N’isto é perfeita a caridade para comnosco, para que no dia do juizo tenhamos confiança, porque qual elle é somos nós tambem n’este mundo.
texts.1jn.4.18: Na caridade não ha temor, antes a perfeita caridade lança fóra o temor; porque o temor tem a pena, e o que teme não está perfeito em caridade.
texts.1jn.4.19: Nós o amamos a elle porque elle nos amou primeiro.
texts.1jn.4.20: Se alguem diz: Eu amo a Deus, e aborrece a seu irmão, é mentiroso. Pois quem não ama a seu irmão, ao qual viu, como pode amar a Deus, a quem não viu?
texts.1jn.4.21: E d’elle temos este mandamento: que quem ama a Deus ame tambem a seu irmão.
texts.1jn.5.1: Todo aquelle que crê que Jesus é o Christo é nascido de Deus; e todo aquelle que ama ao que o gerou tambem ama ao que d’elle é nascido.
texts.1jn.5.2: N’isto conhecemos que amamos os filhos de Deus, quando amamos a Deus e guardamos os seus mandamentos.
texts.1jn.5.3: Porque esta é a caridade de Deus: que guardemos os seus mandamentos; e os seus mandamentos não são pesados.
texts.1jn.5.4: Porque todo o que é nascido de Deus vence o mundo; e esta é a victoria que vence o mundo, a nossa fé.
texts.1jn.5.5: Quem é aquelle que vence o mundo, senão aquelle que crê que Jesus é o Filho de Deus?
texts.1jn.5.6: Este é aquelle que veiu por agua e sangue, Jesus, o Christo: não só por agua, mas por agua e por sangue. E o Espirito é o que testifica, porque o Espirito é a verdade.
texts.1jn.5.7: Porque tres são os que testificam no céu: o Pae, a Palavra, e o Espirito Sancto; e estes tres são um.
texts.1jn.5.8: E tres são os que testificam na terra: o Espirito, e a agua, e o sangue; e estes tres concordam n’um.
texts.1jn.5.9: Se recebemos o testemunho dos homens, o testemunho de Deus é maior; porque é este o testemunho de Deus, que de seu Filho testificou.
texts.1jn.5.10: Quem crê no Filho de Deus, em si mesmo tem o testemunho: quem a Deus não crê mentiroso o fez: porquanto não creu no testemunho que Deus de seu Filho deu.
texts.1jn.5.11: E o testemunho é este: que Deus nos deu a vida eterna; e esta vida está em seu Filho.
texts.1jn.5.12: Quem tem o Filho tem a vida: quem não tem o Filho de Deus não tem a vida.
texts.1jn.5.13: Estas coisas vos escrevi, a vós que crêdes no nome do Filho de Deus, para que saibaes que tendes a vida eterna, e para que creiaes no nome do Filho de Deus.
texts.1jn.5.14: E esta é a confiança que temos para com elle, que, se pedirmos alguma coisa, segundo a sua vontade, elle nos ouve.
texts.1jn.5.15: E, se sabemos que nos ouve em tudo o que pedimos, sabemos que alcançamos as petições que lhe pedimos.
texts.1jn.5.16: Se alguem vir peccar seu irmão peccado que não é para morte, orará, e Deus dará a vida áquelles que não peccarem para morte. Ha peccado para morte, pelo qual não digo que ore.
texts.1jn.5.17: Toda a iniquidade é peccado: e ha peccado que não é para morte.
texts.1jn.5.18: Sabemos que todo aquelle que é nascido de Deus não pecca; mas o que de Deus é gerado conserva-se a si mesmo, e o maligno não lhe toca.
texts.1jn.5.19: Sabemos que somos de Deus, e que todo o mundo jaz no maligno.
texts.1jn.5.20: Porém sabemos que já o Filho de Deus é vindo, e nos deu entendimento para conhecermos o que é verdadeiro; e no que é verdadeiro estamos, em seu Filho Jesus Christo. Este é o verdadeiro Deus e a vida eterna.

texts.1jn.1.1: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the word of life;
texts.1jn.1.2: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and testify, and show to you that eternal life which was with the Father, and was manifested to us;)
texts.1jn.1.3: That which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
texts.1jn.1.4: And these things we write to you, that your joy may be full.
texts.1jn.1.5: This then is the message which we have heard from him, and declare to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
texts.1jn.1.6: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
texts.1jn.1.7: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
texts.1jn.1.8: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
texts.1jn.1.9: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
texts.1jn.1.10: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
texts.1jn.2.1: My little children, these things I write to you, that ye sin not. And if any man sinneth, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
texts.1jn.2.2: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
texts.1jn.2.3: And by this we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
texts.1jn.2.4: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
texts.1jn.2.5: But whoever keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: by this we know that we are in him.
texts.1jn.2.6: He that saith he abideth in him, ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
texts.1jn.2.7: Brethren, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning: The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
texts.1jn.2.8: Again, a new commandment I write to you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
texts.1jn.2.9: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
texts.1jn.2.10: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is no occasion of stumbling in him.
texts.1jn.2.11: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because darkness hath blinded his eyes.
texts.1jn.2.12: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
texts.1jn.2.13: I write to you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write to you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
texts.1jn.2.14: I have written to you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
texts.1jn.2.15: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man loveth the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
texts.1jn.2.16: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not from the Father, but is from the world.
texts.1jn.2.17: And the world passeth away, and the lust of it: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
texts.1jn.2.18: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist cometh, even now are there many antichrists; by which we know that it is the last time.
texts.1jn.2.19: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
texts.1jn.2.20: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
texts.1jn.2.21: I have not written to you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
texts.1jn.2.22: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
texts.1jn.2.23: Whoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: but he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
texts.1jn.2.24: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
texts.1jn.2.25: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
texts.1jn.2.26: These things have I written to you concerning them that seduce you.
texts.1jn.2.27: But the anointing which ye have received from him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man should teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you concerning all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
texts.1jn.2.28: And now, little children, abide in him; that when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
texts.1jn.2.29: If ye know that he is righteous ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
texts.1jn.3.1: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
texts.1jn.3.2: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
texts.1jn.3.3: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
texts.1jn.3.4: Whoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law; for sin is the transgression of the law.
texts.1jn.3.5: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
texts.1jn.3.6: Whoever abideth in him sinneth not: whoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
texts.1jn.3.7: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
texts.1jn.3.8: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
texts.1jn.3.9: Whoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
texts.1jn.3.10: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
texts.1jn.3.11: For this is the message that ye have heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
texts.1jn.3.12: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And why did he slay him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
texts.1jn.3.13: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
texts.1jn.3.14: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother, abideth in death.
texts.1jn.3.15: Whoever hateth his brother, is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
texts.1jn.3.16: By this we perceive the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
texts.1jn.3.17: But he who hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
texts.1jn.3.18: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue, but in deed and in truth.
texts.1jn.3.19: And by this we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
texts.1jn.3.20: For if our heart condemneth us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
texts.1jn.3.21: Beloved, if our heart doth not condemn us, then have we confidence towards God.
texts.1jn.3.22: And whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
texts.1jn.3.23: And this is his commandment; That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
texts.1jn.3.24: And he that keepeth his commandments, dwelleth in him, and he in him. And by this we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
texts.1jn.4.1: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
texts.1jn.4.2: By this ye know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ hath come in the flesh, is from God:
texts.1jn.4.3: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh, is not from God. And this is that spirit of antichrist, of which ye have heard that it should come; and even now already it is in the world.
texts.1jn.4.4: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
texts.1jn.4.5: They are of the world: therefore they speak from the world, and the world heareth them.
texts.1jn.4.6: We are of God. He that knoweth God, heareth us; he that is not of God, heareth not us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
texts.1jn.4.7: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is from God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
texts.1jn.4.8: He that loveth not, knoweth not God; for God is love.
texts.1jn.4.9: In this was manifested the love of God towards us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
texts.1jn.4.10: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
texts.1jn.4.11: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
texts.1jn.4.12: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
texts.1jn.4.13: By this we know that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
texts.1jn.4.14: And we have seen and do testify, that the Father sent the Son to be the Savior of the world.
texts.1jn.4.15: Whoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
texts.1jn.4.16: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love: and he that dwelleth in love, dwelleth in God, and God in him.
texts.1jn.4.17: In this is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
texts.1jn.4.18: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth, is not made perfect in love.
texts.1jn.4.19: We love him, because he first loved us.
texts.1jn.4.20: If a man sayeth, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar. For he that loveth not his brother, whom he hath seen, how can he love God, whom he hath not seen?
texts.1jn.4.21: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God, love his brother also.
texts.1jn.5.1: Whoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ, is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat, loveth him also that is begotten by him.
texts.1jn.5.2: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
texts.1jn.5.3: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments; and his commandments are not grievous.
texts.1jn.5.4: For whatever is born of God, overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
texts.1jn.5.5: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
texts.1jn.5.6: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth testimony, because the Spirit is truth.
texts.1jn.5.7: For there are three that bear testimony in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit, and these three are one.
texts.1jn.5.8: And there are three that bear testimony on earth, the spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
texts.1jn.5.9: If we receive the testimony of men, the testimony of God is greater: for this is the testimony of God which he hath testified of his Son.
texts.1jn.5.10: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God, hath made him a liar, because he hath not believed the testimony that God gave of his Son.
texts.1jn.5.11: And this is the testimony, that God hath given to us eternal life: and this life is in his Son.
texts.1jn.5.12: He that hath the Son, hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God, hath not life.
texts.1jn.5.13: These things have I written to you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
texts.1jn.5.14: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
texts.1jn.5.15: And if we know that he heareth us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired from him.
texts.1jn.5.16: If any man shall see his brother sin a sin which is not to death, he shall ask, and he will give him life for them that sin not to death. There is a sin to death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
texts.1jn.5.17: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not to death.
texts.1jn.5.18: We know that whoever is born of God, sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God, keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
texts.1jn.5.19: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
texts.1jn.5.20: And we know that the Son of God hath come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
texts.1jn.5.21: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.

texts.1jn.1.1: That which was from [the] beginning, that which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes; that which we contemplated, and our hands handled, concerning the word of life;
texts.1jn.1.2: (and the life has been manifested, and we have seen, and bear witness, and report to you the eternal life, which was with the Father, and has been manifested to us:)
texts.1jn.1.3: that which we have seen and heard we report to you, that *ye* also may have fellowship with us; and our fellowship [is] indeed with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
texts.1jn.1.4: And these things write we to you that your joy may be full.
texts.1jn.1.5: And this is the message which we have heard from him, and declare to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
texts.1jn.1.6: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not practise the truth.
texts.1jn.1.7: But if we walk in the light as *he* is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
texts.1jn.1.8: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
texts.1jn.1.9: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us [our] sins, and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
texts.1jn.1.10: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
texts.1jn.2.1: My children, these things I write to you in order that ye may not sin; and if any one sin, we have a patron with the Father, Jesus Christ [the] righteous;
texts.1jn.2.2: and *he* is the propitiation for our sins; but not for ours alone, but also for the whole world.
texts.1jn.2.3: And hereby we know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
texts.1jn.2.4: He that says, I know him, and does not keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him;
texts.1jn.2.5: but whoever keeps his word, in him verily the love of God is perfected. Hereby we know that we are in him.
texts.1jn.2.6: He that says he abides in him ought, even as *he* walked, himself also [so] to walk.
texts.1jn.2.7: Beloved, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment, which ye have had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye heard.
texts.1jn.2.8: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which thing is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing and the true light already shines.
texts.1jn.2.9: He who says he is in the light, and hates his brother, is in the darkness until now.
texts.1jn.2.10: He that loves his brother abides in light, and there is no occasion of stumbling in him.
texts.1jn.2.11: But he that hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and knows not where he goes, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
texts.1jn.2.12: I write to you, children, because [your] sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
texts.1jn.2.13: I write to you, fathers, because ye have known him [that is] from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked [one]. I write to you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
texts.1jn.2.14: I have written to you, fathers, because ye have known him [that is] from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and ye have overcome the wicked [one].
texts.1jn.2.15: Love not the world, nor the things in the world. If any one love the world, the love of the Father is not in him;
texts.1jn.2.16: because all that [is] in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
texts.1jn.2.17: And the world is passing, and its lust, but he that does the will of God abides for eternity.
texts.1jn.2.18: Little children, it is [the] last hour, and, according as ye have heard that antichrist comes, even now there have come many antichrists, whence we know that it is [the] last hour.
texts.1jn.2.19: They went out from among us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have surely remained with us, but that they might be made manifest that none are of us.
texts.1jn.2.20: And *ye* have [the] unction from the holy [one], and ye know all things.
texts.1jn.2.21: I have not written to you because ye do not know the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
texts.1jn.2.22: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? *He* is the antichrist who denies the Father and the Son.
texts.1jn.2.23: Whoever denies the Son has not the Father either; he who confesses the Son has the Father also.
texts.1jn.2.24: As for *you* let that which ye have heard from the beginning abide in you: if what ye have heard from the beginning abides in you, *ye* also shall abide in the Son and in the Father.
texts.1jn.2.25: And this is the promise which *he* has promised us, life eternal.
texts.1jn.2.26: These things have I written to you concerning those who lead you astray:
texts.1jn.2.27: and *yourselves*, the unction which ye have received from him abides in you, and ye have not need that any one should teach you; but as the same unction teaches you as to all things, and is true and is not a lie, and even as it has taught you, ye shall abide in him.
texts.1jn.2.28: And now, children, abide in him, that if he be manifested we may have boldness, and not be put to shame from before him at his coming.
texts.1jn.2.29: If ye know that he is righteous, know that every one who practises righteousness is begotten of him.
texts.1jn.3.1: See what love the Father has given to us, that we should be called [the] children of God. For this reason the world knows us not, because it knew him not.
texts.1jn.3.2: Beloved, now are we children of God, and what we shall be has not yet been manifested; we know that if it is manifested we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is.
texts.1jn.3.3: And every one that has this hope in him purifies himself, even as *he* is pure.
texts.1jn.3.4: Every one that practises sin practises also lawlessness; and sin is lawlessness.
texts.1jn.3.5: And ye know that *he* has been manifested that he might take away our sins; and in him sin is not.
texts.1jn.3.6: Whoever abides in him, does not sin: whoever sins, has not seen him or known him.
texts.1jn.3.7: Children, let no man lead you astray; he that practises righteousness is righteous, even as *he* is righteous.
texts.1jn.3.8: He that practises sin is of the devil; for from [the] beginning the devil sins. To this end the Son of God has been manifested, that he might undo the works of the devil.
texts.1jn.3.9: Whoever has been begotten of God does not practise sin, because his seed abides in him, and he cannot sin, because he has been begotten of God.
texts.1jn.3.10: In this are manifest the children of God and the children of the devil. Whoever does not practise righteousness is not of God, and he who does not love his brother.
texts.1jn.3.11: For this is the message which ye have heard from the beginning, that we should love one another:
texts.1jn.3.12: not as Cain was of the wicked one, and slew his brother; and on account of what slew he him? because his works were wicked, and those of his brother righteous.
texts.1jn.3.13: Do not wonder, brethren, if the world hate you.
texts.1jn.3.14: *We* know that we have passed from death to life, because we love the brethren. He who does not love [his] brother abides in death.
texts.1jn.3.15: Every one that hates his brother is a murderer, and ye know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.
texts.1jn.3.16: Hereby we have known love, because *he* has laid down his life for us; and *we* ought for the brethren to lay down [our] lives.
texts.1jn.3.17: But whoso may have the world's substance, and see his brother having need, and shut up his bowels from him, how abides the love of God in him?
texts.1jn.3.18: Children, let us not love with word, nor with tongue, but in deed and in truth.
texts.1jn.3.19: And hereby we shall know that we are of the truth, and shall persuade our hearts before him --
texts.1jn.3.20: that if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart and knows all things.
texts.1jn.3.21: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, we have boldness towards God,
texts.1jn.3.22: and whatsoever we ask we receive from him, because we keep his commandments, and practise the things which are pleasing in his sight.
texts.1jn.3.23: And this is his commandment, that we believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and that we love one another, even as he has given us commandment.
texts.1jn.3.24: And he that keeps his commandments abides in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abides in us, by the Spirit which he has given to us.
texts.1jn.4.1: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but prove the spirits, if they are of God; because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
texts.1jn.4.2: Hereby ye know the Spirit of God: every spirit which confesses Jesus Christ come in flesh is of God;
texts.1jn.4.3: and every spirit which does not confess Jesus Christ come in flesh is not of God: and this is that [power] of the antichrist, [of] which ye have heard that it comes, and now it is already in the world.
texts.1jn.4.4: *Ye* are of God, children, and have overcome them, because greater is he that [is] in you than he that [is] in the world.
texts.1jn.4.5: *They* are of the world; for this reason they speak [as] of the world, and the world hears them.
texts.1jn.4.6: *We* are of God; he that knows God hears us; he who is not of God does not hear us. From this we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.
texts.1jn.4.7: Beloved, let us love one another; because love is of God, and every one that loves has been begotten of God, and knows God.
texts.1jn.4.8: He that loves not has not known God; for God is love.
texts.1jn.4.9: Herein as to us has been manifested the love of God, that God has sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
texts.1jn.4.10: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son a propitiation for our sins.
texts.1jn.4.11: Beloved, if God has so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
texts.1jn.4.12: No one has seen God at any time: if we love one another, God abides in us, and his love is perfected in us.
texts.1jn.4.13: Hereby we know that we abide in him and he in us, that he has given to us of his Spirit.
texts.1jn.4.14: And *we* have seen, and testify, that the Father has sent the Son [as] Saviour of the world.
texts.1jn.4.15: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
texts.1jn.4.16: And *we* have known and have believed the love which God has to us. God is love, and he that abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
texts.1jn.4.17: Herein has love been perfected with us that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, that even as *he* is, *we* also are in this world.
texts.1jn.4.18: There is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear; for fear has torment, and he that fears has not been made perfect in love.
texts.1jn.4.19: *We* love because *he* has first loved us.
texts.1jn.4.20: If any one say, I love God, and hate his brother, he is a liar: for he that loves not his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
texts.1jn.4.21: And this commandment have we from him, That he that loves God love also his brother.
texts.1jn.5.1: Every one that believes that Jesus is the Christ is begotten of God; and every one that loves him that has begotten loves also him that is begotten of him.
texts.1jn.5.2: Hereby know we that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
texts.1jn.5.3: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments; and his commandments are not grievous.
texts.1jn.5.4: For all that has been begotten of God gets the victory over the world; and this is the victory which has gotten the victory over the world, our faith.
texts.1jn.5.5: Who is he that gets the victory over the world, but he that believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
texts.1jn.5.6: This is he that came by water and blood, Jesus [the] Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that bears witness, for the Spirit is the truth.
texts.1jn.5.7: For they that bear witness are three:
texts.1jn.5.8: the Spirit, and the water, and the blood; and the three agree in one.
texts.1jn.5.9: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater. For this is the witness of God [which] he has witnessed concerning his Son.
texts.1jn.5.10: He that believes on the Son of God has the witness in himself; he that does not believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the witness which God has witnessed concerning his Son.
texts.1jn.5.11: And this is the witness, that God has given to us eternal life; and this life is in his Son.
texts.1jn.5.12: He that has the Son has life: he that has not the Son of God has not life.
texts.1jn.5.13: These things have I written to you that ye may know that ye have eternal life who believe on the name of the Son of God.
texts.1jn.5.14: And this is the boldness which we have towards him, that if we ask him anything according to his will he hears us.
texts.1jn.5.15: And if we know that he hears us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
texts.1jn.5.16: If any one see his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life, for those that do not sin unto death. There is a sin to death: I do not say of that that he should make a request.
texts.1jn.5.17: Every unrighteousness is sin; and there is a sin not to death.
texts.1jn.5.18: We know that every one begotten of God does not sin, but he that has been begotten of God keeps himself, and the wicked [one] does not touch him.
texts.1jn.5.19: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the wicked [one].
texts.1jn.5.20: And we know that the Son of God has come, and has given us an understanding that we should know him that [is] true; and we are in him that [is] true, in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.

texts.1jn.1.1: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we did behold, and our hands did handle, concerning the Word of the Life --
texts.1jn.1.2: and the Life was manifested, and we have seen, and do testify, and declare to you the Life, the age-during, which was with the Father, and was manifested to us --
texts.1jn.1.3: that which we have seen and heard declare we to you, that ye also may have fellowship with us, and our fellowship [is] with the Father, and with His Son Jesus Christ;
texts.1jn.1.4: and these things we write to you, that your joy may be full.
texts.1jn.1.5: And this is the message that we have heard from Him, and announce to you, that God is light, and darkness in Him is not at all;
texts.1jn.1.6: if we may say -- `we have fellowship with Him,' and in the darkness may walk -- we lie, and do not the truth;
texts.1jn.1.7: and if in the light we may walk, as He is in the light -- we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ His Son doth cleanse us from every sin;
texts.1jn.1.8: if we may say -- `we have not sin,' ourselves we lead astray, and the truth is not in us;
texts.1jn.1.9: if we may confess our sins, stedfast He is and righteous that He may forgive us the sins, and may cleanse us from every unrighteousness;
texts.1jn.1.10: if we may say -- `we have not sinned,' a liar we make Him, and His word is not in us.
texts.1jn.2.1: My little children, these things I write to you, that ye may not sin: and if any one may sin, an advocate we have with the Father, Jesus Christ, a righteous one,
texts.1jn.2.2: and he -- he is a propitiation for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world,
texts.1jn.2.3: and in this we know that we have known him, if his commands we may keep;
texts.1jn.2.4: he who is saying, `I have known him,' and his command is not keeping, a liar he is, and in him the truth is not;
texts.1jn.2.5: and whoever may keep his word, truly in him the love of God hath been perfected; in this we know that in him we are.
texts.1jn.2.6: He who is saying in him he doth remain, ought according as he walked also himself so to walk.
texts.1jn.2.7: Brethren, a new command I write not to you, but an old command, that ye had from the beginning -- the old command is the word that ye heard from the beginning;
texts.1jn.2.8: again, a new command I write to you, which thing is true in him and in you, because the darkness doth pass away, and the true light doth now shine;
texts.1jn.2.9: he who is saying, in the light he is, and his brother is hating, in the darkness he is till now;
texts.1jn.2.10: he who is loving his brother, in the light he doth remain, and a stumbling-block in him there is not;
texts.1jn.2.11: and he who is hating his brother, in the darkness he is, and in the darkness he doth walk, and he hath not known whither he doth go, because the darkness did blind his eyes.
texts.1jn.2.12: I write to you, little children, because the sins have been forgiven you through his name;
texts.1jn.2.13: I write to you, fathers, because ye have known him who [is] from the beginning; I write to you, young men, because ye have overcome the evil. I write to you, little youths, because ye have known the Father:
texts.1jn.2.14: I did write to you, fathers, because ye have known him who [is] from the beginning; I did write to you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God in you doth remain, and ye have overcome the evil.
texts.1jn.2.15: Love not ye the world, nor the things in the world; if any one doth love the world, the love of the Father is not in him,
texts.1jn.2.16: because all that [is] in the world -- the desire of the flesh, and the desire of the eyes, and the ostentation of the life -- is not of the Father, but of the world,
texts.1jn.2.17: and the world doth pass away, and the desire of it, and he who is doing the will of God, he doth remain -- to the age.
texts.1jn.2.18: Little youths, it is the last hour; and even as ye heard that the antichrist doth come, even now antichrists have become many -- whence we know that it is the last hour;
texts.1jn.2.19: out of us they went forth, but they were not of us, for if they had been of us, they would have remained with us; but -- that they might be manifested that they are not all of us.
texts.1jn.2.20: And ye have an anointing from the Holy One, and have known all things;
texts.1jn.2.21: I did not write to you because ye have not known the truth, but because ye have known it, and because no lie is of the truth.
texts.1jn.2.22: Who is the liar, except he who is denying that Jesus is the Christ? this one is the antichrist who is denying the Father and the Son;
texts.1jn.2.23: every one who is denying the Son, neither hath he the Father, [he who is confessing the Son hath the Father also.]
texts.1jn.2.24: Ye, then, that which ye heard from the beginning, in you let it remain; if in you may remain that which from the beginning ye did hear, ye also in the Son and in the Father shall remain,
texts.1jn.2.25: and this is the promise that He did promise us -- the life the age-during.
texts.1jn.2.26: These things I did write to you concerning those leading you astray;
texts.1jn.2.27: and you, the anointing that ye did receive from him, in you it doth remain, and ye have no need that any one may teach you, but as the same anointing doth teach you concerning all, and is true, and is not a lie, and even as was taught you, ye shall remain in him.
texts.1jn.2.28: And now, little children, remain in him, that when he may be manifested, we may have boldness, and may not be ashamed before him, in his presence;
texts.1jn.2.29: if ye know that he is righteous, know ye that every one doing the righteousness, of him hath been begotten.
texts.1jn.3.1: See ye what love the Father hath given to us, that children of God we may be called; because of this the world doth not know us, because it did not know Him;
texts.1jn.3.2: beloved, now, children of God are we, and it was not yet manifested what we shall be, and we have known that if he may be manifested, like him we shall be, because we shall see him as he is;
texts.1jn.3.3: and every one who is having this hope on him, doth purify himself, even as he is pure.
texts.1jn.3.4: Every one who is doing the sin, the lawlessness also he doth do, and the sin is the lawlessness,
texts.1jn.3.5: and ye have known that he was manifested that our sins he may take away, and sin is not in him;
texts.1jn.3.6: every one who is remaining in him doth not sin; every one who is sinning, hath not seen him, nor known him.
texts.1jn.3.7: Little children, let no one lead you astray; he who is doing the righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous,
texts.1jn.3.8: he who is doing the sin, of the devil he is, because from the beginning the devil doth sin; for this was the Son of God manifested, that he may break up the works of the devil;
texts.1jn.3.9: every one who hath been begotten of God, sin he doth not, because his seed in him doth remain, and he is not able to sin, because of God he hath been begotten.
texts.1jn.3.10: In this manifest are the children of God, and the children of the devil; every one who is not doing righteousness, is not of God, and he who is not loving his brother,
texts.1jn.3.11: because this is the message that ye did hear from the beginning, that we may love one another,
texts.1jn.3.12: not as Cain -- of the evil one he was, and he did slay his brother, and wherefore did he slay him? because his works were evil, and those of his brother righteous.
texts.1jn.3.13: Do not wonder, my brethren, if the world doth hate you;
texts.1jn.3.14: we -- we have known that we have passed out of the death to the life, because we love the brethren; he who is not loving the brother doth remain in the death.
texts.1jn.3.15: Every one who is hating his brother -- a man-killer he is, and ye have known that no man-killer hath life age-during in him remaining,
texts.1jn.3.16: in this we have known the love, because he for us his life did lay down, and we ought for the brethren the lives to lay down;
texts.1jn.3.17: and whoever may have the goods of the world, and may view his brother having need, and may shut up his bowels from him -- how doth the love of God remain in him?
texts.1jn.3.18: My little children, may we not love in word nor in tongue, but in word and in truth!
texts.1jn.3.19: and in this we know that of the truth we are, and before Him we shall assure our hearts,
texts.1jn.3.20: because if our heart may condemn -- because greater is God than our heart, and He doth know all things.
texts.1jn.3.21: Beloved, if our heart may not condemn us, we have boldness toward God,
texts.1jn.3.22: and whatever we may ask, we receive from Him, because His commands we keep, and the things pleasing before Him we do,
texts.1jn.3.23: and this is His command, that we may believe in the name of His Son Jesus Christ, and may love one another, even as He did give command to us,
texts.1jn.3.24: and he who is keeping His commands, in Him he doth remain, and He in him; and in this we know that He doth remain in us, from the Spirit that He gave us.
texts.1jn.4.1: Beloved, every spirit believe not, but prove the spirits, if of God they are, because many false prophets have gone forth to the world;
texts.1jn.4.2: in this know ye the Spirit of God; every spirit that doth confess Jesus Christ in the flesh having come, of God it is,
texts.1jn.4.3: and every spirit that doth not confess Jesus Christ in the flesh having come, of God it is not; and this is that of the antichrist, which ye heard that it doth come, and now in the world it is already.
texts.1jn.4.4: Ye -- of God ye are, little children, and ye have overcome them; because greater is He who [is] in you, than he who is in the world.
texts.1jn.4.5: They -- of the world they are; because of this from the world they speak, and the world doth hear them;
texts.1jn.4.6: we -- of God we are; he who is knowing God doth hear us; he who is not of God, doth not hear us; from this we know the spirit of the truth, and the spirit of the error.
texts.1jn.4.7: Beloved, may we love one another, because the love is of God, and every one who is loving, of God he hath been begotten, and doth know God;
texts.1jn.4.8: he who is not loving did not know God, because God is love.
texts.1jn.4.9: In this was manifested the love of God in us, because His Son -- the only begotten -- hath God sent to the world, that we may live through him;
texts.1jn.4.10: in this is the love, not that we loved God, but that He did love us, and did send His Son a propitiation for our sins.
texts.1jn.4.11: Beloved, if thus did God love us, we also ought one another to love;
texts.1jn.4.12: God no one hath ever seen; if we may love one another, God in us doth remain, and His love is having been perfected in us;
texts.1jn.4.13: in this we know that in Him we do remain, and He in us, because of His Spirit He hath given us.
texts.1jn.4.14: And we -- we have seen and do testify, that the Father hath sent the Son -- Saviour of the world;
texts.1jn.4.15: whoever may confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God in him doth remain, and he in God;
texts.1jn.4.16: and we -- we have known and believed the love, that God hath in us; God is love, and he who is remaining in the love, in God he doth remain, and God in him.
texts.1jn.4.17: In this made perfect hath been the love with us, that boldness we may have in the day of the judgment, because even as He is, we -- we also are in this world;
texts.1jn.4.18: fear is not in the love, but the perfect love doth cast out the fear, because the fear hath punishment, and he who is fearing hath not been made perfect in the love;
texts.1jn.4.19: we -- we love him, because He -- He first loved us;
texts.1jn.4.20: if any one may say -- `I love God,' and his brother he may hate, a liar he is; for he who is not loving his brother whom he hath seen, God -- whom he hath not seen -- how is he able to love?
texts.1jn.4.21: and this [is] the command we have from Him, that he who is loving God, may also love his brother.
texts.1jn.5.1: Every one who is believing that Jesus is the Christ, of God he hath been begotten, and every one who is loving Him who did beget, doth love also him who is begotten of Him:
texts.1jn.5.2: in this we know that we love the children of God, when we may love God, and His commands may keep;
texts.1jn.5.3: for this is the love of God, that His commands we may keep, and His commands are not burdensome;
texts.1jn.5.4: because every one who is begotten of God doth overcome the world, and this is the victory that did overcome the world -- our faith;
texts.1jn.5.5: who is he who is overcoming the world, if not he who is believing that Jesus is the Son of God?
texts.1jn.5.6: This one is he who did come through water and blood -- Jesus the Christ, not in the water only, but in the water and the blood; and the Spirit it is that is testifying, because the Spirit is the truth,
texts.1jn.5.7: because three are who are testifying [in the heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit, and these -- the three -- are one;
texts.1jn.5.8: and three are who are testifying in the earth], the Spirit, and the water, and the blood, and the three are into the one.
texts.1jn.5.9: If the testimony of men we receive, the testimony of God is greater, because this is the testimony of God that He hath testified concerning His Son.
texts.1jn.5.10: He who is believing in the Son of God, hath the testimony in himself; he who is not believing God, a liar hath made Him, because he hath not believed in the testimony that God hath testified concerning His Son;
texts.1jn.5.11: and this is the testimony, that life age-during did God give to us, and this -- the life -- is in His Son;
texts.1jn.5.12: he who is having the Son, hath the life; he who is not having the Son of God -- the life he hath not.
texts.1jn.5.13: These things I did write to you who are believing in the name of the Son of God, that ye may know that life ye have age-during, and that ye may believe in the name of the Son of God.
texts.1jn.5.14: And this is the boldness that we have toward Him, that if anything we may ask according to his will, He doth hear us,
texts.1jn.5.15: and if we have known that He doth hear us, whatever we may ask, we have known that we have the requests that we have requested from Him.
texts.1jn.5.16: If any one may see his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask, and He shall give to him life to those sinning not unto death; there is sin to death, not concerning it do I speak that he may beseech;
texts.1jn.5.17: all unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not unto death.
texts.1jn.5.18: We have known that every one who hath been begotten of God doth not sin, but he who was begotten of God doth keep himself, and the evil one doth not touch him;
texts.1jn.5.19: we have known that of God we are, and the whole world in the evil doth lie;
texts.1jn.5.20: and we have known that the Son of God is come, and hath given us a mind, that we may know Him who is true, and we are in Him who is true, in His Son Jesus Christ; this one is the true God and the life age-during!
texts.1jn.5.21: Little children, guard yourselves from the idols! Amen.

texts.1jn.1.1: Lo que era desde el principio, lo que hemos oído, lo que hemos visto con nuestros ojos, lo que hemos mirado, y nuestras manos han tocado, del Verbo de vida:
texts.1jn.1.2: (Porque la vida fue manifestada; y lo vimos, y testificamos, y os anunciamos la vida eterna, la cual estaba con el Padre, y se nos ha manifestado:)
texts.1jn.1.3: Lo que hemos visto y oído, eso os anunciamos para que también vosotros tengáis comunión con nosotros, y nuestra comunión verdaderamente es con el Padre, y con su Hijo Jesu Cristo.
texts.1jn.1.4: Y estas cosas os escribimos, para que vuestro gozo sea cumplido.
texts.1jn.1.5: Pues éste es el mensaje que hemos oído de él mismo, y que os anunciamos a vosotros: Que Dios es luz, y no hay ningunas tinieblas en él.
texts.1jn.1.6: Si nosotros dijéremos que tenemos comunión con él, y andamos en tinieblas, mentimos, y no hacemos la verdad.
texts.1jn.1.7: Mas si andamos en la luz, como él está en la luz, tenemos comunión los unos con los otros, y la sangre de Jesu Cristo su Hijo nos limpia de todo pecado.
texts.1jn.1.8: Si dijéremos que no tenemos pecado, engañámonos a nosotros mismos, y no hay verdad en nosotros.
texts.1jn.1.9: Si confesamos nuestros pecados, él es fiel y justo para que nos perdone nuestros pecados, y nos limpie de toda maldad.
texts.1jn.1.10: Si dijéremos que no hemos pecado, le hacemos a él mentiroso, y su palabra no está en nosotros.
texts.1jn.2.1: Hijitos míos, estas cosas os escribo, para que no pequéis; y si alguno hubiere pecado, un abogado tenemos para con el Padre, a Jesu Cristo el Justo:
texts.1jn.2.2: Y él es la propiciación por nuestros pecados; y no solamente por los nuestros, mas también por los de todo el mundo.
texts.1jn.2.3: Y por esto sabemos que nosotros le hemos conocido, si guardamos sus mandamientos.
texts.1jn.2.4: El que dice: Yo le he conocido, y no guarda sus mandamientos, el tal es mentiroso, y no hay verdad en él.
texts.1jn.2.5: Mas el que guarda su palabra, el amor de Dios es verdaderamente perfecto en él: por esto sabemos que estamos en él.
texts.1jn.2.6: El que dice que está en él, debe andar como él anduvo.
texts.1jn.2.7: Hermanos, no os escribo un mandamiento nuevo, sino el mandamiento antiguo, que habéis tenido desde el principio: el mandamiento antiguo es la palabra que habéis oído desde el principio.
texts.1jn.2.8: Otra vez os escribo un mandamiento nuevo, que es la verdad en él, y en vosotros; porque las tinieblas están pasando, y la verdadera luz ya alumbra.
texts.1jn.2.9: El que dice que está en la luz, y aborrece a su hermano, el tal aun está en tinieblas todavía.
texts.1jn.2.10: El que ama a su hermano, está en la luz, y no hay escándalo en él.
texts.1jn.2.11: Empero el que aborrece a su hermano, está en tinieblas, y anda en tinieblas, y no sabe donde se va; porque las tinieblas le han cegado los ojos.
texts.1jn.2.12: Hijitos, os escribo que vuestros pecados os son perdonados por causa de su nombre.
texts.1jn.2.13: Padres, os escribo que habéis conocido a aquel que es desde el principio. Mancebos, os escribo que habéis vencido al maligno. Hijitos, os escribo que habéis conocido al Padre.
texts.1jn.2.14: Padres, os he escrito que habéis conocido al que es desde el principio. Mancebos, yo os escribí que sois fuertes, y que la palabra de Dios mora en vosotros, y que habéis vencido al maligno.
texts.1jn.2.15: No améis al mundo, ni las cosas que están en el mundo. Si alguno ama al mundo, el amor del Padre no está en él.
texts.1jn.2.16: Porque todo lo que hay en el mundo, que es concupiscencia de la carne, y concupiscencia de los ojos, y soberbia de la vida, no es del Padre, mas es del mundo.
texts.1jn.2.17: Y el mundo se pasa, y su concupiscencia; mas el que hace la voluntad de Dios, permanece para siempre.
texts.1jn.2.18: Hijitos, ya es la postrera hora; y como vosotros habéis oído que el anticristo ha de venir, así también al presente han comenzado a ser muchos anticristos, por lo cual sabemos que ya es la postrimera hora.
texts.1jn.2.19: Ellos salieron de entre nosotros, mas no eran de nosotros; porque si fueran de nosotros, hubieran cierto permanecido con nosotros; empero esto es para que se manifestase que todos no son de nosotros.
texts.1jn.2.20: Mas vosotros tenéis la unción del Santo, y conocéis todas las cosas.
texts.1jn.2.21: No os he escrito, como si ignoraseis la verdad, mas como a los que la conocéis, y que ninguna mentira es de la verdad.
texts.1jn.2.22: ¿Quién es mentiroso, sino el que niega que Jesús es el Cristo? éste es el anticristo, que niega al Padre, y al Hijo.
texts.1jn.2.23: Cualquiera que niega al Hijo, este tal tampoco tiene al Padre. (Empero) cualquiera que confiesa al Hijo, tiene también al Padre.
texts.1jn.2.24: Pues lo que habéis oído desde el principio, sea permaneciente en vosotros; porque si lo que habéis oído desde el principio fuere permaneciente en vosotros, también vosotros permaneceréis en el Hijo, y en el Padre.
texts.1jn.2.25: Y esta es la promesa, la cual él nos prometió, que es vida eterna.
texts.1jn.2.26: Estas cosas os he escrito tocante a los que os engañan.
texts.1jn.2.27: Empero la unción que vosotros habéis recibido de él, mora en vosotros; y no tenéis necesidad que ninguno os enseñe; mas como la unción misma os enseña de todas cosas, y es verdadera, y no es mentira, así como os ha enseñado, perseverád en él.
texts.1jn.2.28: Y ahora, hijitos, perseverád en él; para que cuando apareciere, tengamos confianza, y no seamos confundidos por él en su venida.
texts.1jn.2.29: Si sabéis que él es justo, sabéd también que cualquiera que hace justicia, es nacido de él.
texts.1jn.3.1: Mirád cual amor nos ha dado el Padre, que seamos llamados hijos de Dios: por esto el mundo no nos conoce, porque no le conoce a él.
texts.1jn.3.2: Amados míos, ahora somos nosotros los hijos de Dios, y aun no es manifestado lo que hemos de ser: empero sabemos que cuando él apareciere, seremos semejantes a él; porque le veremos como él es.
texts.1jn.3.3: Y cualquiera que tiene esta esperanza en él se purifica a sí mismo, como él es puro.
texts.1jn.3.4: Cualquiera que hace pecado, traspasa también la ley; porque el pecado es la transgresión de la ley.
texts.1jn.3.5: Y sabéis que él apareció para quitar nuestros pecados, y no hay pecado en él.
texts.1jn.3.6: Cualquiera que permanece en él, no peca: cualquiera que peca, no le ha visto, y no le ha conocido.
texts.1jn.3.7: Hijitos, ninguno os engañe: el que hace justicia es justo, como él también es justo.
texts.1jn.3.8: El que hace pecado, es del diablo; porque el diablo peca desde el principio. Para esto apareció el Hijo de Dios, para que deshaga las obras del diablo.
texts.1jn.3.9: Cualquiera que es nacido de Dios, no hace pecado; porque su simiente mora en él; y no puede pecar, porque es nacido de Dios.
texts.1jn.3.10: En esto son manifiestos los hijos de Dios, y los hijos del diablo: cualquiera que no hace justicia, y que no ama a su hermano, no es de Dios.
texts.1jn.3.11: Porque éste es el mensaje que habéis oído desde el principio, que nos amemos unos a otros:
texts.1jn.3.12: No como Caín, que era del maligno, y mató a su hermano. ¿Y por qué causa le mató? Porque sus obras eran malas, y las de su hermano eran justas.
texts.1jn.3.13: Hermanos míos, no os maravilléis si el mundo os aborrece.
texts.1jn.3.14: Nosotros sabemos que somos pasados de muerte a vida, en que amamos a los hermanos. El que no ama a su hermano, está en muerte.
texts.1jn.3.15: Cualquiera que aborrece a su hermano, es homicida; y sabéis que ningún homicida tiene vida eterna permaneciente en sí.
texts.1jn.3.16: En esto hemos conocido el amor de Dios, en que él puso su vida por nosotros, y nosotros debemos poner nuestras vidas por los hermanos.
texts.1jn.3.17: Mas el que tuviere bienes de este mundo, y viere a su hermano tener necesidad, y le cerrare sus entrañas, ¿cómo es posible que permanezca el amor de Dios en él?
texts.1jn.3.18: Hijitos míos, no amemos de palabra, ni de lengua; sino con obra y de verdad.
texts.1jn.3.19: Y en esto conocemos que nosotros somos de la verdad, y persuadiremos nuestros corazones delante de él.
texts.1jn.3.20: Porque si nuestro corazón nos reprende, mayor es Dios que nuestro corazón, y sabe todas las cosas.
texts.1jn.3.21: Carísimos, si nuestro corazón no nos reprende, confianza tenemos en Dios;
texts.1jn.3.22: Y cualquiera cosa que pidiéremos, la recibiremos de él; porque guardamos sus mandamientos, y hacemos las cosas que son agradables delante de él.
texts.1jn.3.23: Y éste es su mandamiento: Que creamos en el nombre de su Hijo Jesu Cristo, y nos amemos unos a otros, como nos lo ha mandado.
texts.1jn.3.24: Y el que guarda sus mandamientos, mora en él, y él en él. Y en esto sabemos que él mora en nosotros, por el Espíritu que nos ha dado.
texts.1jn.4.1: Amados, no creáis a todo espíritu; sino probád los espíritus si son de Dios. Porque muchos falsos profetas son salidos en el mundo.
texts.1jn.4.2: En esto se conoce el Espíritu de Dios: Todo espíritu que confiesa que Jesu Cristo es venido en carne, es de Dios;
texts.1jn.4.3: Y todo espíritu que no confiesa que Jesu Cristo es venido en carne, no es de Dios; y este tal espíritu es espíritu del anticristo, del cual vosotros habéis oído que ha de venir, y que ahora ya está en el mundo.
texts.1jn.4.4: Hijitos, vosotros sois de Dios, y los habéis vencido; porque el que en vosotros está, es mayor que el que está en el mundo.
texts.1jn.4.5: Ellos son del mundo, por eso hablan del mundo, y el mundo los oye.
texts.1jn.4.6: Nosotros somos de Dios: el que conoce a Dios, es nuestro escuchador: el que no es de Dios, no nos presta oídos. Por esto conocemos el espíritu de verdad, y el espíritu de error.
texts.1jn.4.7: Carísimos, amémonos unos a otros; porque el amor es de Dios. Y cualquiera que ama, es nacido de Dios, y conoce a Dios.
texts.1jn.4.8: El que no ama, no conoce a Dios; porque Dios es amor.
texts.1jn.4.9: En esto se mostró el amor de Dios en nosotros, en que Dios envió su Hijo unigénito al mundo, para que vivamos por él.
texts.1jn.4.10: En esto consiste el amor, no que nosotros hayamos amado a Dios, sino que él nos amó a nosotros, y envió a su Hijo para ser propiciación por nuestros pecados.
texts.1jn.4.11: Amados, si Dios nos ha así amado, debemos también nosotros amarnos los unos a los otros.
texts.1jn.4.12: Ninguno vio jamás a Dios. Si nos amamos los unos a los otros, Dios está en nosotros, y su amor es perfecto en nosotros.
texts.1jn.4.13: En esto conocemos que moramos en él, y él en nosotros, en que nos ha dado de su Espíritu.
texts.1jn.4.14: Y nosotros hemos visto, y testificamos que el Padre ha enviado a su Hijo para ser Salvador del mundo.
texts.1jn.4.15: Cualquiera que confesare que Jesús es el Hijo de Dios, Dios está en él, y él en Dios.
texts.1jn.4.16: Y nosotros hemos conocido, y creído el amor que Dios tiene por nosotros. Dios es amor; y el que mora en amor mora en Dios, y Dios en él.
texts.1jn.4.17: En esto es perfecto el amor con nosotros, para que tengamos confianza en el día del juicio, que cual él es, tales somos nosotros en este mundo.
texts.1jn.4.18: En el amor no hay temor; mas el perfecto amor echa fuera el temor; porque el temor tiene castigo. De donde el que teme, no es perfecto en el amor.
texts.1jn.4.19: Nosotros le amamos a él, porque él primero nos amó.
texts.1jn.4.20: Si alguno dice: Yo amo a Dios, y aborrece a su hermano, es mentiroso. Porque el que no ama a su hermano, al cual ha visto, ¿cómo puede amar a Dios, que no ha visto?
texts.1jn.4.21: Y nosotros tenemos este mandamiento de él: Que el que ama a Dios, ame también a su hermano.
texts.1jn.5.1: Todo aquel que cree que Jesús es el Cristo, es nacido de Dios; y cualquiera que ama al que ha engendrado, ama también al que es engendrado de él.
texts.1jn.5.2: En esto conocemos que amamos a los hijos de Dios, cuando amamos a Dios, y guardamos sus mandamientos.
texts.1jn.5.3: Porque éste es el amor de Dios, que guardemos sus mandamientos; y sus mandamientos no son graves.
texts.1jn.5.4: Porque todo aquello que es nacido de Dios vence al mundo; y esta es la victoria que vence al mundo, es a saber, nuestra fe.
texts.1jn.5.5: ¿Quién es el que vence al mundo, sino el que cree que Jesús es el Hijo de Dios?
texts.1jn.5.6: Este es Jesu Cristo, que vino por agua y sangre: no por agua solamente, sino por agua y sangre. Y el Espíritu es el que da testimonio; porque el Espíritu es la verdad.
texts.1jn.5.7: Porque tres son los que dan testimonio en el cielo, el Padre, el Verbo, y el Espíritu Santo; y estos tres son uno.
texts.1jn.5.8: También son tres los que dan testimonio en la tierra, el espíritu, y el agua, y la sangre; y estos tres son uno.
texts.1jn.5.9: Si recibimos el testimonio de los hombres, el testimonio de Dios es mayor; porque éste es el testimonio de Dios, que ha testificado de su Hijo.
texts.1jn.5.10: El que cree en el Hijo de Dios, tiene el testimonio en sí mismo. El que no cree a Dios, ha hecho mentiroso a Dios; porque no ha creído en el testimonio que Dios ha testificado de su Hijo.
texts.1jn.5.11: Y éste es el testimonio, es a saber, que Dios nos ha dado vida eterna, y que esta vida está en su Hijo.
texts.1jn.5.12: El que tiene al Hijo, tiene la vida; el que no tiene al Hijo de Dios, no tiene vida.
texts.1jn.5.13: Yo he escrito estas cosas a vosotros que creeis en el nombre del Hijo de Dios; para que sepáis que tenéis vida eterna, y para que creáis en el nombre del Hijo de Dios.
texts.1jn.5.14: Y esta es la confianza que tenemos en él, que si demandáremos alguna cosa conforme a su voluntad, él nos oye.
texts.1jn.5.15: Y si sabemos que él nos oye en cualquiera cosa que demandáremos, también sabemos que tenemos las peticiones que le hubiéremos demandado.
texts.1jn.5.16: Si alguno viere pecar a su hermano pecado que no es de muerte, demandará a Dios, y él le dará vida; digo a los que pecan no de muerte. Hay pecado de muerte: por el cual yo no digo que ruegues.
texts.1jn.5.17: Toda iniquidad es pecado; empero hay pecado que no es de muerte.
texts.1jn.5.18: Bien sabemos que cualquiera que es nacido de Dios, no peca; mas el que es engendrado de Dios, se guarda a sí mismo, y el maligno no le toca.
texts.1jn.5.19: Sabido tenemos que somos de Dios, y todo el mundo está puesto en el maligno.
texts.1jn.5.20: Empero sabemos que el Hijo de Dios es venido, y nos ha dado entendimiento, para conocer al que es verdadero; y estamos en el verdadero, en su Hijo Jesu Cristo. Este es el verdadero Dios, y la vida eterna.
texts.1jn.5.21: Hijitos, guardáos de los ídolos. Amén.

texts.1jn.1.1: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we for ourselves gazed upon, and our hands did handle, concerning the Word of Life,—
texts.1jn.1.2: And, the Life, was made manifest, and we have seen, and are bearing witness, and announcing unto you, the Age-abiding Life, which, indeed, was with the Father, and was made manifest unto us;
texts.1jn.1.3: That which we have seen and heard, are we announcing, even unto you, in order that, ye too, may have fellowship with us, and, our own fellowship also, may be with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
texts.1jn.1.4: And, these things, are we writing, in order that, our joy, may be made full.
texts.1jn.1.5: And this is the message which we have heard from him, and are reporting unto you,—that, God, is, light, and in him is, no darkness at all.
texts.1jn.1.6: If we say—We have, fellowship, with him! and, in darkness, are walking, we are dealing falsely, and not doing the truth;
texts.1jn.1.7: Whereas, if, in the light, we are walking, as, he, is in the light, we have, fellowship one with another, and, the blood of Jesus his Son, is cleansing us from all sin.
texts.1jn.1.8: If we say—Sin, have we none! we are deceiving, ourselves, and, the truth, is not in us.
texts.1jn.1.9: If we are confessing our sins, faithful, is he and, righteous—that he should forgive us our sins, and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
texts.1jn.1.10: If we say—We have not sinned! false, are we making, him, and, his word, is not in us.
texts.1jn.2.1: My dear children! these things, am I writing unto you, in order that ye may not be committing sin. And, if anyone should commit sin, an Advocate, have we, with the Father, Jesus Christ, the Righteous;
texts.1jn.2.2: And, he, is, a propitiation, concerning our sins,—and, not concerning our own only, but, also concerning those of the whole world.
texts.1jn.2.3: And, hereby, perceive we, that we understand him,—if, his commandments, we are keeping.
texts.1jn.2.4: He that saith—I understand him! And, his commandments, is not keeping, is false, and, in him, the truth is not!
texts.1jn.2.5: But whosoever may be keeping his word, of a truth, in this man, the love of God hath been made perfect. Hereby, perceive we, that, in him, we are.
texts.1jn.2.6: He that saith, that, in him, he abideth, ought, just as He walked, himself also, to be walking.
texts.1jn.2.7: Beloved! no new commandment, am I writing unto you; but an old commandment, which ye have been holding from the beginning: The old commandment is the word which ye have heard.
texts.1jn.2.8: Again, a new commandment, am I writing unto you,—which thing is true, in him and in you, because, the darkness, is passing away, and, the real light, already is shining.
texts.1jn.2.9: He that saith he is, in the light, and hateth, his brother, is, in the darkness, until even now!
texts.1jn.2.10: He that loveth his brother, is abiding, in the light, and, cause of stumbling, in him, is there none.
texts.1jn.2.11: Whereas, he that hateth his brother, in the darkness, dwelleth, and in the darkness, walketh; and knoweth not whither he is drifting, because the, darkness, hath blinded his eyes.
texts.1jn.2.12: I write unto you, dear children, because your sins have been forgiven you, for the sake of his name:
texts.1jn.2.13: I write unto you, fathers, because ye understand him who was from the beginning: I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I have written unto you, little children, because ye understand the Father:
texts.1jn.2.14: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye understand him who was from the beginning: I have written you, young men, because ye are, strong, and the word of God, within you, abideth, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
texts.1jn.2.15: Be not loving the world, nor yet the things that are in the world: if anyone be loving the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
texts.1jn.2.16: Because, all that is in the world—the coveting of the flesh, the coveting of the eyes, and the vain grandeur of life—is not of the Father, but is, of the world;
texts.1jn.2.17: And, the world, passeth away, and the coveting [thereof], but, he that doeth the will of God, endureth unto times age-abiding.
texts.1jn.2.18: Little children! it is, the last hour; and, just as ye have heard that, an antichrist, is coming, even now, antichrists have become, many, whence we perceive that it is, the last hour:
texts.1jn.2.19: From among us, they went out, but they were not of us; for, if, of us, they had been, they would in that case have abode with us; but [it came to pass] in order that they might be made manifest, because, all, are not of us.
texts.1jn.2.20: And, ye, have, an anointing, from the Holy One,—Ye all, know:
texts.1jn.2.21: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and because, no falsehood, is, of the truth.
texts.1jn.2.22: Who, is the False One;—save he that denieth that, Jesus, is the Christ? The same, is the Antichrist,—he that denieth the Father and the Son.
texts.1jn.2.23: Whosoever denieth the Son, neither hath he, the Father: He that confesseth the Son, hath, the Father also.
texts.1jn.2.24: As for you, what ye have heard from the beginning, in you, let it abide. If, in you, shall abide, that which, from the beginning, ye have heard, ye also, in the Son, and [in] the Father, shall abide.
texts.1jn.2.25: And, this, is the promise, which he hath promised unto us,—The age-abiding life.
texts.1jn.2.26: These things, have I written unto you, concerning them who would lead you astray.
texts.1jn.2.27: And, as for you, the anointing which ye have received from him, abideth in you, and ye have, no need, that anyone be teaching you; but, as, his anointing, is teaching you, and is, true, and is no falsehood, even just as it hath taught you, abide ye in him.
texts.1jn.2.28: And, now, dear children, abide ye in him, in order that, if he be made manifest, we may have boldness, and not be shamed away from him by his presence.
texts.1jn.2.29: If ye know that he is, righteous, ye perceive that—whosoever doeth righteousness, of him, hath been born.
texts.1jn.3.1: Behold, what manner of love, the Father hath bestowed upon us—that, children of God, we should be called,—and such we are! Therefore, the world understandeth us not, because it understood not him.
texts.1jn.3.2: Beloved! now, are we, children of God; and, not yet, hath it been made manifest, what we shall be,—We know that, if it should be made manifest, like unto him, shall we be, because we shall see him, just as he is.
texts.1jn.3.3: And, whosoever hath this hope on him, is purifying himself, just as, He, is pure.
texts.1jn.3.4: Whosoever is committing sin, lawlessness also, is committing, and, sin, is, lawlessness;
texts.1jn.3.5: And ye know, that, He, was made manifest—in order that, our sins, he should take away, and, sin, in him, is there none.
texts.1jn.3.6: Whosoever, in him, doth abide, is not sinning: whosoever is sinning, hath not seen him, and doth not understand him.
texts.1jn.3.7: Dear children! Let, no one, lead you astray! He that is doing righteousness, is, righteous, just as, He, is righteous:
texts.1jn.3.8: He that is committing sin, is, of the adversary, because, from the beginning, the adversary is sinning. To this end, was the Son of God made manifest, in order that he might undo the works of the adversary.
texts.1jn.3.9: Whosoever hath been born of God, is not committing, sin, because, a seed of him, within him, abideth; and he cannot be committing sin, because, of God, hath he been born.
texts.1jn.3.10: Herein, are, manifest, the children of God, and the children of the adversary: Whoever is not doing righteousness, is not of God, nor yet he that is not loving his brother.
texts.1jn.3.11: Because, this, is the message which ye have heard from the beginning—that we should be loving one another,—
texts.1jn.3.12: Not just as, Cain, was, of the wicked one, and slew his brother! And, for what cause, slew he him? Because, his works, were, wicked, whereas, those of his brother, were, righteous.
texts.1jn.3.13: Be not marveling, brethren, if, the world, is hating you:
texts.1jn.3.14: We, know, that we have passed over out of death into life, because we love the brethren: he that loveth not, abideth in death.
texts.1jn.3.15: Whosoever is hating his brother, is, a murderer; and ye know that, no murderer, hath life age-during, within him abiding.
texts.1jn.3.16: Hereby, have we come to understand love: in that, He, for us, his life laid down; and, we, ought, for the brethren, our lives to lay down.
texts.1jn.3.17: But, whoso hath this world’s goods, and beholdeth his brother having, need, and shutteth up his tender affections from him, how, is, the love of God, abiding in him?
texts.1jn.3.18: Dear children! Let us not be loving in word, nor yet with the tongue, but in deed and truth.
texts.1jn.3.19: Hereby, shall we get to know, that, of the truth, we are, and, before him, shall persuade our heart;
texts.1jn.3.20: Because, if our own heart condemn us, greater, is God, than our heart, and perceiveth all things.
texts.1jn.3.21: Beloved! if our heart be not condemning us, boldness, have we, towards God;
texts.1jn.3.22: And, whatsoever we are asking, we are receiving from him, because, his commandments, are we keeping, and, the things that are pleasing before him, are we doing.
texts.1jn.3.23: And, this, is his commandment,—that we should believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and be loving one another—just as he gave a commandment unto us.
texts.1jn.3.24: And, he that keepeth his commandments, in him, abideth, and, he, in him. And, hereby, perceive we, that he abideth in us, by reason of the Spirit which, unto us, he hath given.
texts.1jn.4.1: Beloved! not in every spirit, believe ye, but test the spirits, whether they are, of God; because, many false prophets, have gone out into the world.
texts.1jn.4.2: Hereby, do ye perceive the Spirit of God:—every spirit that confesseth Jesus Christ as having come, in flesh, is, of God;
texts.1jn.4.3: And, every spirit that doth not confess Jesus, of God, is not. And, this, is the [spirit] of the Antichrist, touching which ye have heard that it cometh: even now, is it, in the world, already.
texts.1jn.4.4: Ye, are, of God, dear children, and have overcome them; because, greater, is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
texts.1jn.4.5: They, are, of the world: For this cause, of the world, they speak, and the world, unto them, doth hearken.
texts.1jn.4.6: We, are, of God: he that is getting to understand God, hearkeneth unto us,—whoso is not of God, hearkeneth not unto us: from this, perceive we—the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
texts.1jn.4.7: Beloved! let us be loving one another; because, love, is, of God, and, whosoever loveth, of God, hath been born, and is getting to understand God:
texts.1jn.4.8: He that doth not love, doth not understand God, because, God, is, love.
texts.1jn.4.9: Herein, hath the love of God in us, been made manifest, that, his only-begotten Son, God sent into the world, in order that we might live through him.
texts.1jn.4.10: Herein, is love: not that, we, have loved God, but that, he, loved us, and sent forth his Son, as a propitiation concerning our sins.
texts.1jn.4.11: Beloved! If, in this way, God, loved us, we also, ought to love, one another.
texts.1jn.4.12: Upon God, hath no one, at any time, gazed: If we love one another, God, in us, abideth, and, his love, hath been perfected within us.
texts.1jn.4.13: Hereby, perceive we—that, in him, are we abiding, and, he, in us,—in that, of his Spirit, hath he given unto us.
texts.1jn.4.14: And, we, for ourselves have gazed, and are bearing witness—that, the Father, sent forth the Son, as Saviour of the world.
texts.1jn.4.15: Whosoever shall confess, that, Jesus [Christ] is the Son of God, God, in him, abideth, and, he, in God.
texts.1jn.4.16: And, we, have come to understand and to trust the love which, God, hath, in us. God, is, love; and, he that abideth in love, in God, abideth, and, God, in him [abideth].
texts.1jn.4.17: Herein, hath love with us, been made perfect,—in order that, boldness, we might have in the day of judging,—in that, just as, He, is, we also, are, in this world.
texts.1jn.4.18: Fear, existeth not, in love, but, perfect love, casteth fear, outside; because, fear, hath correction: he that feareth, hath not been made perfect, in love.
texts.1jn.4.19: We, love, because, he, first loved us:—
texts.1jn.4.20: If one should say, I love God, and should be hating, his brother, false, is he; for, he that doth not love his brother, whom he hath seen, God, whom he hath not seen, he cannot love!
texts.1jn.4.21: And, this commandment, have we from him,—that, he who loveth God, love, his brother also.
texts.1jn.5.1: Whosoever believeth that, Jesus, is the Christ, of God, hath been born: and, whosoever loveth him that begat, loveth him that hath been begotten of him.
texts.1jn.5.2: Hereby, perceive we, that we love the children of God, as soon as, God, we love, and, his commandments, we are doing.
texts.1jn.5.3: For, this is the love of God—that, his commandments, we be keeping, and, his commandments, are not burdensome;
texts.1jn.5.4: Because, whatsoever hath been born of God, overcometh the world; and, this, is the victory that hath overcome the world—our faith.
texts.1jn.5.5: [And] who is he that overcometh the world, save he that believeth that, Jesus, is the Son of God?
texts.1jn.5.6: This, is he that came through means of water and blood, Jesus Christ: not, by the water, only, but, by the water and by the blood,—and, the Spirit, it is, that is bearing witness, because, the Spirit, is the truth.
texts.1jn.5.7: Because, three, are they who are bearing witness—
texts.1jn.5.8: The Spirit, and the Water, and the Blood; and, the three, are, [witnesses], unto one thing.
texts.1jn.5.9: If, the witness of men, we receive, the witness of God, is, greater. Because, this, is the witness of God—in that he hath borne witness concerning his Son,—
texts.1jn.5.10: He that believeth on the Son of God, hath the witness, within himself: He that doth not believe God, false, hath made him,—because he hath not believed on the witness which, God, hath witnessed, concerning his Son—
texts.1jn.5.11: And, this, is the witness:—that, life age-abiding, hath God given unto us, and, this life, is, in his Son:
texts.1jn.5.12: He that hath the Son, hath, the life,—he that hath not the Son of God, hath not, the life.
texts.1jn.5.13: These things, have I written unto you—in order that ye may know that ye have, Life Age-abiding—unto you who believe on the name of the Son of God.
texts.1jn.5.14: And, this, is the boldness which we have towards him: that, if, anything, we ask, according to his will, He doth hearken unto us.
texts.1jn.5.15: And, if we know that he doth hearken unto us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the things asked, which we have asked of him,
texts.1jn.5.16: If one should see his brother committing a sin, not unto death, he shall ask, and He will grant unto him life,—for them who are sinning, not unto death. There, is, a sin, unto death: not concerning that, am I saying, that he should make request.
texts.1jn.5.17: All unrighteousness, is, sin, and there, is, a sin, not unto death.
texts.1jn.5.18: We know that, whosoever hath been born of God, is not committing sin,—Nay, he that hath been born of God, He keepeth him, and, the wicked one, doth not touch him.
texts.1jn.5.19: We know that, of God, are we; and, the whole world, in the wicked one, is lying.
texts.1jn.5.20: We know, moreover, that, the Son of God, hath come, and hath given us insight, so that we are getting to understand, him that is Real,—and we are in him that is Real, in his Son Jesus Christ. This, is the Real God, and life age-abiding.
texts.1jn.5.21: Dear children! Guard yourselves from idols.

texts.1jn.1.1: Lo que era desde el principio, lo que hemos oído, lo que hemos visto con nuestros ojos, lo que vimos y nuestras manos tocaron, acerca de la Palabra de vida
texts.1jn.1.2: (y la vida se reveló, y hemos visto, y damos testimonio, y os anunciamos la vida, la vida eterna, que estaba con el Padre y se nos reveló);
